justification: Both target the inference from a magnitude bound on the error term to its derivative being O(z^{-1}). The assessment’s witness is valid: |sin(x^3)/x|≤1/x, but at x_n=(2πn)^{1/3}, its derivative equals 3x_n, contradicting O(x^{-1}). It also correctly identifies the displayed bound as c|z|.
